content.text: Let me try the update again:

input.note: The PVC is stuck in Terminating because the ledger-db-0 pod is still running and actively using it. The kubernetes.io/pvc-protection finalizer prevents deletion while a pod uses the volume [cite: concepts/storage/persistent-volumes#storage-object-in-use-protection-0]. To resolve: terminate the ledger-db-0 pod or its StatefulSet first, then the PVC deletion will complete.
